repairs.verified_title: Interleukin-1-receptor antagonist in type 2 diabetes mellitus.
repairs.described_as: IL-1 receptor antagonist in type 2 diabetes and beta cell preservation (Larsen, NEJM)
repairs.why: Builder asserted NEJM 2012; the anakinra T2D NEJM paper is 2007. 22723585 is a fructose/glycemic-control systematic review in Diabetes Care.

repairs.verified_title: Preventing beta-cell loss and diabetes with calcium channel blockers.
repairs.described_as: Verapamil blocks TXNIP and protects beta cells from apoptosis (Shalev)
repairs.why: Builder asserted Cell Metabolism 2014; the Shalev TXNIP/CCB beta-cell paper is Diabetes 2012. 24931610 is a SETD2 histone methylation paper in Cell Reports.

repairs.verified_title: International trial of the Edmonton protocol for islet transplantation.
repairs.why: 19148081 is "Your inbox, Mr President.", a Nature 2009 editorial. Published on the site as GOLD-tier evidence.

repairs.described_as: GLP-1 receptor agonists enhance islet graft function in rodent transplant models (Markmann, Transplantation 2017)
repairs.why: 28864502 is a sulfonylurea cardiovascular-risk paper in Diabetes Care. Searches for Markmann islet 2017 and for GLP-1/islet-transplantation/graft-function returned no paper matching this description. No substitute is asserted.

repairs.described_as: Etanercept and instant blood-mediated inflammatory reaction in islet transplantation (Bennet, Transplantation 2005)
repairs.why: 15644441 is a placental syncytin gene paper in PNAS. Bennet's IBMIR paper is Ups J Med Sci 2000 (11095109) and concerns no etanercept; the etanercept islet trial found is a 2023 pilot (36443174). Neither is the asserted paper.

repairs.described_as: Instant blood-mediated inflammatory reaction in islet transplantation: mechanisms and mitigation (Nilsson, Transplantation Reviews 2006)
repairs.why: 16498215 is a rabbit calvarial bone transport paper in Neurol Med Chir. No 2006 Nilsson IBMIR review was located; the nearest is Curr Opin Organ Transplant 2011 (21971510), which is a different paper.

repairs.verified_title: Decline Pattern of Beta-cell Function in Adult-onset Latent Autoimmune Diabetes: an 8-year Prospective Study.
repairs.described_as: Biphasic C-peptide decline in Chinese LADA cohort (2020)
repairs.why: 31529065 is a mobile-app psychosocial study in JAMIA. The described study is the Central South University 8-year LADA beta-cell decline cohort. Builder had named Zhou as first author; PubMed lists Li X first, so authors are corrected too.

repairs.verified_title: UKPDS 25: autoantibodies to islet-cell cytoplasm and glutamic acid decarboxylase for prediction of insulin requirement in type 2 diabetes.
repairs.described_as: UKPDS: 84% GADA+ patients require insulin by 6 years
repairs.why: 9742976 is UKPDS 33 (intensive glucose control), which contains no autoantibody prediction result. The GADA/ICA insulin-requirement finding is UKPDS 25.

repairs.verified_title: Low C-peptide together with a high glutamic acid decarboxylase autoantibody level predicts progression to insulin dependence in latent autoimmune diabetes in adults.
repairs.described_as: HUNT study autoantibody risk stratification; HR 6.40 low C-peptide, HR 5.37 high GADA titre
repairs.why: 30369313 is a cardiac resynchronisation therapy outcomes paper in JAHA. Sorgjerd/Asvold are the HUNT (Nord-Trondelag) group and this is the paper carrying the C-peptide/GADA hazard ratios the record cites.

repairs.verified_title: Adult-onset autoimmune diabetes in Europe is prevalent with a broad clinical phenotype: Action LADA 7.
repairs.described_as: ACTION LADA: clinical and genetic characteristics of LADA (Hawa, Diabetes Care 2013)
repairs.why: 23835333 is the teplizumab anti-CD3 C-peptide paper in Diabetes - a real diabetes paper, which is why the topic screen passed it and only title agreement caught it.
